PLAN "12-Week Strength Return for Post-Meniscus Tear"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build strength and support knee rehab for skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Stability" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core & Mobility":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
